paper_title: Riding the dark matter wave: Novel limits on general dark photons from LISA Pathfinder
suggested_experiment_name: LISA Pathfinder (SC-TM relative acceleration, auxiliary channels)
coupling_convention: epsilon_{B-L}: relative coupling strength as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3 (DP coupling relative to electric charge); the gauge coupling is g_{B-L} = epsilon_{B-L} * e. Values emitted exactly as plotted (epsilon), NOT converted to g_BL.
notes: Paper derives new B-L (and B) dark photon dark matter limits from LISA Pathfinder SC-TM auxiliary channel data (April 2016 noise run, SNR<=1 criterion), world-leading for 4e-19 eV < m < 3e-17 eV. No numerical table is given; limits are shown only in figures (fig. 3 for eps_{B-L}, fig. 5 for g_BL). Emitted data points are a physics-based reconstruction: peak sensitivity near m ~ 5e-18 eV (f ~ 1e-3 Hz) where the paper states it beats MICROSCOPE (g_BL ~ few x 1e-25) by >2 orders of magnitude, with endpoints at the stated world-leading mass-range boundaries where the limit meets MICROSCOPE. Values are approximate (factor ~2-3 uncertainty). Paper also presents projections (LPF full dataset, LISA) not included here. The exclusion uses SNR=1 rather than a formal confidence level.
